info.short_description: Geographic identifier. This file is national only; geography always holds the value 'United States'.

info.long_name: Cumulative measles cases in the United States
info.short_description: Year-to-date cumulative count of confirmed measles cases in the United States.
info.long_description: Cumulative count of confirmed measles cases in the United States from the start of the calendar year through the reporting week. Stratified by age group (<5, 5-19, 20+, Total) and vaccination status (Total, Unvaccinated/Unknown, One dose MMR, Two doses MMR). Negative values reflect CDC retroactive corrections. Cases are classified following CSTE case definitions.
info.statement: In the United States, {value} cumulative measles cases were reported as of {time}.

info.long_name: New measles cases reported in the United States for the reporting week
info.short_description: Weekly new count of confirmed measles cases in the United States.
info.long_description: Count of newly confirmed measles cases in the United States for the reporting week. Stratified by age group (<5, 5-19, 20+, Total) and vaccination status (Total, Unvaccinated/Unknown, One dose MMR, Two doses MMR). Negative values reflect CDC retroactive corrections. Cases are classified following CSTE case definitions.
info.statement: In the United States, {value} new measles cases were reported for the week ending {time}.

info.long_name: New measles-associated hospitalizations reported in the United States for the reporting week
info.short_description: Weekly new count of measles-associated hospitalizations in the United States.
info.long_description: Count of newly reported measles-associated hospitalizations in the United States for the reporting week. Stratified by age group (<5, 5-19, 20+, Total) and vaccination status (Total, Unvaccinated/Unknown, One dose MMR, Two doses MMR). Negative values reflect CDC retroactive corrections.
info.statement: In the United States, {value} new measles-associated hospitalizations were reported for the week ending {time}.

info.long_name: Cumulative measles-associated hospitalizations in the United States
info.short_description: Year-to-date cumulative count of measles-associated hospitalizations in the United States.
info.long_description: Cumulative count of measles-associated hospitalizations in the United States from the start of the calendar year through the reporting week. Stratified by age group (<5, 5-19, 20+, Total) and vaccination status (Total, Unvaccinated/Unknown, One dose MMR, Two doses MMR). Negative values reflect CDC retroactive corrections.
info.statement: In the United States, {value} cumulative measles-associated hospitalizations were reported as of {time}.

info.long_name: Age group stratification for measles cases
info.short_description: Age group of measles cases. When an age-specific group is shown, vax_group is 'Total'.
info.long_description: Age group stratification for measles case counts. Values include '<5 years', '5-19 years', '20+ years', and 'Total'. When age is one of the age-specific values, vax_group is always 'Total'. When age is 'Total', vax_group varies across vaccination status categories.

info.long_name: Vaccination status stratification for measles cases
info.short_description: Vaccination status of measles cases. Only varies when age is 'Total'.
info.long_description: Vaccination status stratification for measles case counts. Values include 'Total', 'Unvaccinated/Unknown', 'One dose MMR', and 'Two doses MMR'. Rows with age-specific groups (<5, 5-19, 20+) always have vax_group set to 'Total'. 'Unvaccinated/Unknown' includes persons with no measles-containing vaccine doses or unknown vaccination history.

info.long_name: Measles case or hospitalization count (cumulative or new, by age and vaccination status)
info.short_description: Count of measles cases or hospitalizations, either cumulative year-to-date or new for the reporting week, stratified by age group and vaccination status.
info.long_description: Count of confirmed measles cases or associated hospitalizations in the United States, stratified by age group and vaccination status. The type column indicates whether the value is a cumulative year-to-date count or a newly reported count for the reporting week, and whether it counts cases or hospitalizations ('cumulative cases', 'new cases', 'new hospitalizations', 'cumulative hospitalizations'). Negative values may reflect retroactive corrections by the CDC. Cases are classified as confirmed or probable following CSTE case definitions. Vaccination-status counts are approximated by multiplying cumulative totals by the reported percentage in each status category.
info.statement: In the United States, {value} measles cases were reported.

info.long_name: Cumulative measles cases in the United States
info.short_description: Year-to-date cumulative count of confirmed measles cases in the United States.
info.long_description: Cumulative count of confirmed measles cases in the United States from the start of the calendar year through the reporting week. Stratified by age group (<5, 5-19, 20+, Total) and vaccination status (Total, Unvaccinated/Unknown, One dose MMR, Two doses MMR). Negative values reflect CDC retroactive corrections. Cases are classified following CSTE case definitions.
info.statement: In the United States, {value} cumulative measles cases were reported as of {time}.

cdc_measles_cases_vax.short_name: CDC measles cases by vaccination status
cdc_measles_cases_vax.short_description: Rows stratified by vaccination status (vax_group other than 'Total'); measles case/hospitalization counts approximated from CDC-reported percentages by vaccination status.

info.short_description: Flag indicating whether a county value is actually a state-level estimate applied to the county (1) rather than a county-specific measurement (0).
info.long_description: Indicator (0/1) that a county row carries a state-level estimate rather than a value measured at the county level. Set to 1 when the underlying source only reports at the state level (e.g. some vaccine exemption estimates), and 0 otherwise. Missing values are coded as 0.

info.long_name: Measles virus detection rate in wastewater surveillance
info.short_description: Percentage of wastewater samples with measles virus detection
info.long_description: The detection rate represents the proportion of wastewater samples that tested positive for measles virus RNA across participating wastewater treatment facilities. This metric is calculated by dividing the total number of detections by the total number of samples collected and multiplying by 100. Higher detection rates may indicate increased measles virus circulation in the community served by the wastewater treatment facilities.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of wastewater samples tested positive for measles virus

vaccine_exemption_rate.long_name: Kindergarten non-medical MMR Vaccine Exemption Rate (County)
vaccine_exemption_rate.short_description: Percentage of kindergartners with non-medical exemptions from MMR vaccination requirements at county level.
vaccine_exemption_rate.long_description: County-level percentage of kindergartners with non-medical exemptions from MMR vaccination requirements. Compiled from state-reported exemption data spanning 2009–2024. County-level coverage varies by state, as not all states report at the county level. Data from Fattah et al. 2026 (JAMA).

info.short_description: Value for the measles-related measure identified by the source column. Units vary by source.
info.long_description: Combined county-level measles indicators from multiple sources in long format. The source column identifies the measure type: wastewater_detection_rate (% wastewater samples positive; CDC NWSS), vaccine_exemption_rate (% kindergartners with MMR exemptions; Fattah et al.), jhu_measles_cases (weekly confirmed case counts; JHU), mmr_coverage_healthmap (estimated % children with MMR coverage; HealthMap), wapo_county_vax_rate (county MMR vaccination rate; Washington Post). Units and time resolutions differ by source.

The source column identifies the measure type: wastewater_detection_rate (% wastewater samples positive; CDC NWSS), vaccine_exemption_rate (% kindergartners with MMR exemptions; Fattah et al.), jhu_measles_cases (weekly confirmed case counts; JHU), mmr_coverage_healthmap (estimated % children with MMR coverage; HealthMap), wapo_county_vax_rate (county MMR vaccination rate; Washington Post). Units and time resolutions differ by source.

bundle_measles/dist/measles_cases_by_age.long_name: Measles case or hospitalization count (cumulative or new, by age and vaccination status)
bundle_measles/dist/measles_cases_by_age.short_description: Count of measles cases or hospitalizations, either cumulative year-to-date or new for the reporting week, stratified by age group and vaccination status.
bundle_measles/dist/measles_cases_by_age.long_description: Count of confirmed measles cases or associated hospitalizations in the United States, stratified by age group and vaccination status. The type column indicates whether the value is a cumulative year-to-date count or a newly reported count for the reporting week, and whether it counts cases or hospitalizations ('cumulative cases', 'new cases', 'new hospitalizations', 'cumulative hospitalizations'). Negative values may reflect retroactive corrections by the CDC. Cases are classified as confirmed or probable following CSTE case definitions. Vaccination-status counts are approximated by multiplying cumulative totals by the reported percentage in each status category.
bundle_measles/dist/measles_cases_by_age.statement: In the United States, {value} measles cases were reported.

cdc_measles_age2.name: CDC Measles Cases and Outbreaks - Age and Vaccination Status
cdc_measles_age2.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
cdc_measles_age2.description: Weekly new and cumulative case counts for measles in the United States, stratified by age group (<5, 5-19, 20+, and Total) and vaccination status (Total, Unvaccinated/Unknown, One dose MMR, Two doses MMR). Data are updated weekly on the CDC Measles Cases and Outbreaks surveillance page. Negative values in case counts reflect retroactive corrections by the CDC. Cases are classified as confirmed or probable following CSTE case definitions. New weekly counts are derived from successive differences in cumulative counts. Vaccination status case counts are approximated by multiplying cumulative totals by the reported percentage in each status category.
